headlines.title: ‘Only Go Into Physical Stores Every Sixth Week’: Clark Howard’s Anti-Impulse Rule as Costco Hits $1,025
headlines.summary: Clark Howard spent years watching couples bleed money one warehouse trip at a time, and the fix he landed on sounds almost too simple to work. With Costco shares surging past $1,000 and the holiday treasure-hunt season starting, the math behind his rule gets uncomfortable fast.

headlines.title: In 1975, Sol Price Was Pushed Out of FedMart, the Discount Chain He Founded. The Warehouse Store He Opened Next Became Part of Costco
headlines.summary: A lawyer-turned-retailer got fired from the discount chain he built over two decades, and the warehouse he opened next with a handful of friends and a converted Hughes property became the blueprint for one of the most powerful retail businesses on the planet.

headlines.title: Jim Cramer Says Costco Is Still a Great Value. Charlie Munger’s Rule Explains Why
headlines.summary: Charlie Munger once said Costco is the one stock where you can look past the P/E. After a month-long rally, that exception faces its toughest test yet, and the business and the price may tell two different stories.

headlines.title: Costco retains BofA "buy" as October US comps rise 8.1%
headlines.summary: Costco Wholesale Corporation (NASDAQ:COST, XETRA:CTO) US comparable sales accelerated in October, prompting Bank of America to maintain its "buy" rating. US comparable sales excluding gasoline price changes rose 8.

headlines.title: Jackery Expands Retail Footprint of Award-Winning FridgeGuard, Announces First-Ever Holiday Promotional Pricing for Black Friday and Cyber Monday
headlines.summary: Formerly exclusive to Costco, the critically acclaimed home backup system is now available on Amazon and Jackery.com, offering consumers new ways to shop as well as unprecedented seasonal savings FREMONT, Calif., Nov. 05, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Jackery, a global leader in innovative portable power and The World's No. 1 Solar Generator Brand*, today announced the expanded retail availability of its highly acclaimed FridgeGuard appliance backup system.

description: Costco Wholesale Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the operation of membership warehouses in the United States, Puerto Rico, Canada, Mexico, Japan, the United Kingdom, Korea, Australia, Taiwan, China, Spain, France, Sweden, Iceland, and New Zealand. It offers merchandise, including sundries, dry groceries, candies, coolers, freezers, liquor, and tobacco; non-food merchandise comprising consumer electronics, appliances, small electrics, health and beauty aids, hardware, lawn and garden, sporting goods, tires, toys and seasonal, automotive, stamps, tickets, apparel, furniture, domestics, housewares, special order kiosks, and jewelry; and fresh food, such as meat, produce, deli, and bakery products. The company is also involved in warehouse ancillary operations, which include gasoline, pharmacies, food courts, optical, hearing aids, and tire installation centers. In addition, it engages in e-commerce, business centers, travel, and other businesses. Further, the company operates e-commerce sites; and offers branded and private-label products in various categories. The company was formerly known as Costco Companies, Inc. and changed its name to Costco Wholesale Corporation in August 1999. Costco Wholesale Corporation was founded in 1976 and is based in Issaquah, Washington.
